notes:
v1.18 (2026-08-31): Added the MD-VA zone - Baltimore MD (DMA 512, 269 ZIPs), Norfolk-Portsmouth-Newport News VA (DMA 544, 284 ZIPs incl. 68 NE North Carolina), and Richmond-Petersburg VA (DMA 556, 230 ZIPs). 783 ZIPs total, 609 of which have a ZCTA polygon; the remaining 174 are PO-box-only ZIPs with no shape, same as the NY/NJ pass. Ownership left OPEN pending the national sales manager, matching how NY-NJ has sat since 2026-08-20. Rendered under one MD/VA button in index.html. Run migrateZoneIds() after deploying so any existing Sheet rows in these ZIPs pick up the zone. v1.17 (2026-08-20): LA-CENTRAL account_manager changed from Zoila Ladd to Bobby Seng. The 2026-08-03 revert (commit 3bb51ed "revert back to 3 zones in LA market") restored LA-CENTRAL in this file but migrateZoneIds() was never re-run, so the Sheet still carried the v1.15 disbanded layout - 381 LA rows sitting in LA-WEST/LA-EAST that belong in LA-CENTRAL. Setting the owner BEFORE that migration means those 381 rows get their zone_id and account_manager stamped once, correctly, rather than being written to Zoila and re-written to Bobby. Zoila Ladd retains LA-EAST. No ZIP assignment changed in this version; LA-CENTRAL's 142 ZIPs are exactly as v1.14/v1.16 had them.

v1.16 (2026-08-20): Added New York + New Jersey as a single OPEN zone (NY-NJ, account_manager "Open"). 2,913 ZIPs covering both entire states across 11 DMAs, sourced from the national ZIP->DMA crosswalk (Zip Code list.xlsx), Tier 1 and Tier 2 only. Ownership left unassigned on the national sales manager's instruction; split the zone when reps are named. No existing zone, ZIP assignment, colour or manager was touched - LA-CENTRAL's pending owner change is being handled separately. polygon_overlays untouched (cosmetic, no NY/NJ key needed). New market_views entry "NY_NJ" drives the single NY/NJ button's centre and zoom.

v1.12 (2026-05-20): Restructured the Chicago + Milwaukee market. Same three managers (Ana Lopes, Elizabeth Varela, Jorge Rodriguez) but new geographic split. Ana's IL footprint shrinks to just the northern strips of Lake County IL and McHenry County IL (lat >= ~42.31, the towns nearest the WI border) plus Great Lakes Naval Station (60088). Liz now owns the southwest IL collar: all of Kane, DeKalb, Kendall, Grundy, LaSalle, plus west DuPage (Wheaton/Naperville/Glen Ellyn), west Will (Plainfield/Bolingbrook/Romeoville), west Kankakee, NW Cook (Schaumburg/Hoffman Estates/Palatine 60067), south McHenry (Crystal Lake/Algonquin/Cary), and two west Lake-IL ZIPs (Barrington 60010, Wauconda 60084). Jorge gets almost all of Cook County (the city of Chicago and nearly every suburb except the NW sliver), east DuPage, east Will, east Kankakee, the south Lake-IL east-shore corridor (Highland Park/Lake Forest/Libertyville/Vernon Hills/Deerfield/Buffalo Grove/Mundelein/Lake Zurich), and unchanged: all NW Indiana (Lake-IN, Porter, LaPorte, Newton, Jasper). LaSalle County (26 ZIPs) moves back to Liz, reversing the v1.7 transfer. The `northern_il_to_milwaukee` county_list fallback rule is REMOVED — the Lake/McHenry IL ZIPs are now split between three managers, so a wholesale county-based fallback would be wrong. Any new Lake/McHenry IL ZIP added later will require an explicit assignment. The `milwaukee_market` rule (Milwaukee DMA -> Ana) is retained unchanged. New totals: Ana 188 (was 212), Liz 142 (was 128), Jorge 266 (was 256). Market total unchanged at 596.

Chicago-CENTRAL.label: Chicago Central & Western Suburbs
Chicago-CENTRAL.description: NW Cook (Schaumburg/Hoffman Estates/Streamwood/Hanover Park/Palatine 60067), west DuPage (Wheaton/Naperville/Glen Ellyn/Bloomingdale/Bartlett), all Kane (Aurora/Elgin/Geneva/St. Charles), all DeKalb, all Kendall (Yorkville/Oswego), all Grundy (Morris), all LaSalle (Ottawa/Streator), west Will (Plainfield/Bolingbrook/Romeoville), west Kankakee, south McHenry (Crystal Lake/Algonquin/Cary/Lake in the Hills), and two west Lake-IL ZIPs (Barrington 60010, Wauconda 60084).

Chicago-SOUTH.label: Chicago City, South Suburbs & NW Indiana
Chicago-SOUTH.description: Almost all of Cook County (the city of Chicago plus nearly every suburb except the NW sliver), east DuPage (Itasca/Addison/Lombard/Downers Grove/Woodridge), east Will (Joliet/Lockport/Manhattan/Lemont), east Kankakee (Kankakee/Bourbonnais/Manteno), the south Lake-IL east-shore corridor (Highland Park/Lake Forest/Libertyville/Vernon Hills/Deerfield/Buffalo Grove/Mundelein/Lake Zurich/Lake Bluff/Highwood/Lincolnshire), and all of NW Indiana (Lake, Porter, LaPorte, Newton, Jasper counties).

Milwaukee + N. IL.label: Milwaukee + N. Illinois
Milwaukee + N. IL.description: All of the Milwaukee DMA (Milwaukee/Waukesha/Racine/Kenosha/Sheboygan/Dodge/Walworth/Washington/Jefferson/Ozaukee counties in WI), the northern strip of Lake County IL (Waukegan/Gurnee/Antioch/Zion/Round Lake/Grayslake/Wadsworth — roughly north of lat 42.31), the northern strip of McHenry County IL (McHenry/Woodstock/Harvard/Hebron/Richmond/Spring Grove), and Great Lakes Naval Station (60088).

LA-WEST.label: LA — West Basin, Valley & Coast
LA-WEST.description: West LA basin and coast, South Bay, PV peninsula, Wilmington, Malibu, all of Long Beach, plus the San Fernando Valley, Glendale, Burbank, Santa Clarita Valley and all of Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Oxnard, Ventura, Ojai, Simi Valley, Camarillo).

LA-CENTRAL.label: LA — Central Basin, SGV & Antelope Valley
LA-CENTRAL.description: Central LA basin (downtown, East LA), San Gabriel Valley, Pasadena-area foothills, the LA-County east valley (Glendora, San Dimas, Claremont, Pomona, Diamond Bar), north Orange County (Anaheim, Santa Ana, Fullerton, Garden Grove, Westminster), and the Antelope Valley high desert (Lancaster, Palmdale, Acton).

LA-EAST.label: LA — Inland Empire & South OC
LA-EAST.description: Inland Empire (Ontario, San Bernardino, Riverside, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga), south Orange County (Irvine, Mission Viejo, San Juan Capistrano), the eastern Mojave high desert and Inyo County desert (Death Valley, Bishop, Lone Pine).

SAC-METRO.label: Sacramento Metro & Foothills
SAC-METRO.description: Sacramento-Stockton-Modesto DMA: the Sacramento metro, Stockton and San Joaquin Valley, Modesto/Stanislaus, the Solano and Yolo corridor, and the Sierra foothill counties (Placer, El Dorado, Amador, Calaveras, Tuolumne, Nevada, Plumas, Sierra). 365 Tier 1 ZIPs across 17 counties.

NY-NJ.label: New York + New Jersey (unassigned)
NY-NJ.description: All of New York State and all of New Jersey - 11 Nielsen DMAs: New York NY, Philadelphia PA (South Jersey), Buffalo, Rochester, Albany-Schenectady-Troy, Syracuse, Utica, Binghamton, Watertown, Elmira (Corning), and Burlington-Plattsburgh VT-NY. 2,913 ZIPs. Ownership intentionally left OPEN per the national sales manager, 2026-08-20 - split this zone when reps are named.

MD-VA.label: Maryland + Virginia (unassigned)
MD-VA.description: Baltimore MD, Norfolk-Portsmouth-Newport News VA and Richmond-Petersburg VA - 3 Nielsen DMAs, 783 ZIPs. The Norfolk DMA crosses the state line into 68 northeastern North Carolina ZIPs; they belong to this zone because the DMA is the unit of sale, not the state. Ownership intentionally left OPEN, 2026-08-31 - split this zone when reps are named.

assignment_rules.description: v1.8 (2026-05-19): Every ZIP in the LA + Chicago + Milwaukee DMAs assigned to a zone. v1.8 LA restructure: 4 zones -> 3. LA-NORTH dissolved; its ZIPs split between LA-WEST (SFV/Glendale/Burbank/Santa Clarita/Ventura), LA-CENTRAL (Antelope Valley desert) and LA-EAST (Inyo County desert). All Long Beach ZIPs consolidated into LA-WEST. 12 LA-County east-valley ZIPs moved from old LA-INLAND into LA-CENTRAL. Each ZIP reassignment is a single-line edit to the array below. v1.9 adds SAC-METRO (365 Sacramento DMA ZIPs). Must evaluate before market_match / county_list fallbacks. v1.12 (2026-05-20): Chicago/Milwaukee market restructured. Ana Lopes now owns only the WI DMA plus the northern strips of Lake/McHenry IL plus Great Lakes 60088. Elizabeth Varela owns the SW IL collar (Kane/DeKalb/Kendall/Grundy/LaSalle, west DuPage, west Will, NW Cook, west Kankakee, south McHenry, plus Barrington/Wauconda). Jorge Rodriguez owns Cook County proper, east DuPage/Will/Kankakee, south Lake-IL east shore, and all NW Indiana. v1.18 (2026-08-31): appended 783 Baltimore / Norfolk / Richmond ZIPs under the MD-VA zone.
Entire Milwaukee market goes to the combined Milwaukee + N. IL zone.

polygon_overlays._comment: Approximate visual polygons for the map's zone overlays. These DO NOT drive assignment — they're cosmetic. Assignment is governed entirely by assignment_rules above. Polygons are arrays of [lat, lng] vertices.

tuning_notes: If Chicago Central managers push back on volume (currently 265 each), the agreed adjustment is to shift Cook County far-north suburbs (Evanston, Skokie, Niles) into the Milwaukee + N. IL zone. To do this, add a rule above chicago_central that matches Cook County + lat >= ~42.0 (or specific zips) and assigns Milwaukee + N. IL.

LA polygon vertices follow approximate freeway alignments: 710 (~lng -118.18 to -118.20), 57 (~lng -117.86), 55 (~lng -117.87), 605 (~lng -118.10), and the 5/101 in downtown (~lng -118.22). To shift a boundary, find the rule and adjust the vertex coordinates. A 0.01° change is roughly 1km.
Albert/Julie boundary at the Hollywood Hills is a horizontal line at lat 34.13. Pasadena/Glendale (Julie) and the San Fernando Valley (Albert) are separated by this latitude.

Alex/Julie split in downtown LA uses the 5 freeway / LA river (lng -118.225) as the boundary in the band lat 33.99-34.10, and the 710 (lng -118.18) elsewhere. This gives Julie a slice of east downtown.
Polygon overlays are cosmetic only. Edit them to change what the map renders. Edit the assignment_rules polygons to change actual zone assignment.
Account managers were updated to real names on 2026-05-01: Alex Acuna, Albert Trevino, Julie Lin, Zoila Ladd (Chicago/Milwaukee still TBD).

2026-05-01 (v1.2): Extended Albert's territory west through full Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Oxnard, Ventura, Ojai). Carved Burbank out of Albert and gave it to Julie. Changed Julie's color from green (#16a34a) to vivid purple (#9333ea) for better visibility. Visual overlays now match assignment polygons exactly (flush, not inset).

2026-05-01 (v1.2): Fixed pre-existing gap on Malibu coast. Alex's western edge now extends to lng -118.75, sharing a boundary with Albert's new Ventura coast step. Malibu now properly assigned to Alex.

2026-05-01 (v1.3): Chicago Central/South split is no longer a flat horizontal line. South now claims a downtown lakefront corridor (lng -87.75 to lake, up to lat 41.90) and the Berwyn area (lng -87.85 to -87.75, up to lat 41.86). Oak Park stays in Central. Implementation: converted chicago_central and chicago_south rules from lat_band to polygon. The northern_il_to_milwaukee rule still runs first to peel off Lake/McHenry IL.

2026-05-07 (v1.4): zip_assignments rule replaces polygon-based assignment. To move ZIP X from zone A to zone B, edit assignment_rules[0].params.zips: remove X from A's array, add to B's array. Apps Script update is pending — until then, the nightly geocoder still uses the polygon rules from v1.3 (which remain in the bound script even though they're absent from this file). The map's coloring uses zip_assignments only.

2026-05-07 (v1.5): LA shake-up. Renamed zone IDs to be neutral (LA-NORTH/WEST/EAST/INLAND). Swapped Alex↔Albert as managers of North↔West. Moved 40 ZIPs (Bel Air → Glendale strip) into LA-NORTH. The Apps Script's migrateZoneIds_() function rewrote all existing zone_id and account_manager values in the Sheet by re-running the assignment dispatch — so any address whose ZIP is in the snap rule got the correct new zone + manager automatically.

2026-05-07 (v1.6): Moved 25 SBD ZIPs (high desert + eastern Mojave) from LA-NORTH to LA-INLAND. Alex Acuna's territory shrinks to metro LA / Antelope Valley / Inyo County desert. Zoila Ladd's territory expands to cover the full San Bernardino County extent outside Inyo (Riverside County + all of SBD).
2026-05-08 (v1.7): 4 LaSalle County IL ZIPs (61316/61321/61354/61358) moved from Chicago-CENTRAL to Chicago-SOUTH after visual confirmation they sit inside Jorge's surrounding territory.

2026-05-19 (v1.8): LA restructured 4 zones -> 3. LA-NORTH dissolved, Alex Acuna off the LA market (-> Sacramento, Task 2). LA-WEST = old LA-WEST + SFV/Glendale/Burbank/Santa Clarita/Ventura + all Long Beach (218 ZIPs). LA-CENTRAL = old LA-EAST minus Long Beach + Antelope Valley desert + 12 LA-County east-valley ZIPs (144 ZIPs). LA-EAST = old LA-INLAND minus those 12 + 10 Inyo desert ZIPs (150 ZIPs). North OC stays in LA-CENTRAL. LA total 512 unchanged. polygon_overlays NOT updated (cosmetic, not drawn). Run migrateZoneIds() after committing.

2026-05-19 (v1.9): Added Sacramento market. SAC-METRO zone, 365 Tier 1 ZIPs, Alex Acuna. Single zip_list assignment, no new rule type. index.html updated: market detection now reads the geojson market_name property (marketNameToMarket) instead of guessing market from state, so the two CA markets (Los Angeles, Sacramento) are distinguished correctly. To split SAC-METRO into multiple zones later, partition the ZIP array as usual.
2026-05-19 (v1.10): SAC-METRO color #1dffc1 -> #6d28d9. Cosmetic only.
2026-05-19 (v1.11): Burbank 91501 and 91504 moved LA-CENTRAL -> LA-WEST so all five Burbank ZIPs sit in one zone. LA-WEST 220, LA-CENTRAL 142.

2026-05-20 (v1.12): Chicago + Milwaukee restructure. Ana ceded 24 IL ZIPs (12 to Liz, 12 to Jorge) along a new southern boundary at lat ~42.31 across Lake/McHenry IL, keeping the WI border strip. Liz lost 79 ZIPs to Jorge (most of Cook + east DuPage) and gained 81 from Jorge (LaSalle/Kane/Kendall/Grundy/DeKalb/west DuPage/west Will/west Kankakee/NW Cook) plus 12 from Ana (south McHenry, Barrington/Wauconda). Jorge net +10. Boundary rule: any IL ZIP east of a piecewise-linear line from Mundelein (lat 42.26, lng -88.04) south through Palatine/Elk Grove/Itasca/Lombard/Downers Grove/Lemont/Joliet/Manhattan/Manteno/Bourbonnais (lat 41.12, lng -87.86) belongs to Jorge; west of that line belongs to Liz (unless north of lat 42.31 in Lake/McHenry, which is Ana). 60088 Great Lakes pinned to Ana by override (geographically just south of Ana's strip but surrounded by her ZIPs). REMOVED: northern_il_to_milwaukee county_list fallback — wholesale Lake/McHenry-to-Ana is no longer correct. RETAINED: milwaukee_market (Milwaukee DMA -> Ana) — still correct.

2026-06-19 (v1.13): Manager-only swap, no boundary/ZIP changes. Chicago-CENTRAL account_manager Elizabeth Varela -> Jorge Rodriguez (Jorge now owns Chicago-CENTRAL + Chicago-SOUTH). LA-CENTRAL account_manager Julie Lin -> Zoila Ladd (Zoila now owns LA-CENTRAL + LA-EAST). Zone IDs, labels, colors, descriptions, and ZIP lists unchanged; both zones stay distinct. Elizabeth Varela and Julie Lin removed from the active manager roster. index.html unchanged (manager pills dedupe by name, so each now owns two zones under one pill). Run migrateZoneIds() after committing — this reassigns affected Cricket rows to the new managers AND assigns the newly loaded Non-Wireless Investor (MTL) rows their zone_id + account_manager by ZIP in the same pass.

2026-07-01 (v1.14): Manager-only swap, no boundary/ZIP changes. LA-WEST account_manager Albert Trevino -> Alex Acuna. Alex now owns SAC-METRO (Sacramento) + LA-WEST (Los Angeles) under one manager pill. Albert Trevino removed from the active manager roster. Zone IDs, labels, colors, descriptions, and ZIP lists unchanged. index.html unchanged (manager pills dedupe by name). Run migrateZoneIds() after committing to re-stamp all existing LA-WEST rows to Alex Acuna; future rows inherit the new manager automatically from the nightly geocoder.
